items.author: Frederick Jensen, Oct 22
items.summary: Benchmarked 7 Claude and GPT models at 3 effort levels, producing 63 Power BI reports built by an agentic Fabric app. The cheapest production-ready report cost $1.51 and took 9 minutes.
